name: python
description: Python linting and formatting with ruff and type checking with pyright, plus the pyright language server via pyright-lsp. Requires ruff and pyright to be installed (or reachable via uvx/npx).

auto_suppress.title: Auto-suppress unfixable findings
auto_suppress.description: When the fix loop hits its attempt cap, write inline `# noqa` / `# pyright: ignore[...]` comments into your files for whatever is still failing. Off by default: the remaining findings are only reported.
